title: Frenz.fi
tagline: Agentic Socialcoin Launchpad and Open-Source Branding Platform
description:
🚀 Agentic Socialcoin Launchpad + 🧬 Open-Source Branding Platform — a toolkit to evolve any token into a community-powered brand. We provide creators and holders with powerful tools like customizable branding modules, 💧 liquidity optimization hooks, token-based access controls, and 🛡️ built-in insurance for holders affected by rugpulls, LP drains, or suspicious activity. 

Whether it starts as a meme or a movement, any token can now grow into a trusted, protected, and engaged social currency — driven by data, powered by community.
how_its_made:
We started this project to solve a clear problem: tokens launched on platforms like pump.fun or flaunch.gg often get hyped, pumped, and then forgotten. Most don’t have any real utility, protection for users, or a way to grow into something meaningful. Our goal is to give these tokens the tools to evolve into actual social currencies with value, safety, and community support.

We used Nodit on Base to deploy smart contracts and access on-chain data like wallet balances, transaction history, and block info. We connected Nodit’s Web3 Data API to our AI agent system, which helps track token activity and give users simple insights about token health and behavior.

To generate sustainable value, we integrated with Celo and Uniswap v4. On Celo, we built smart contract Hooks that optimize yield while adding MEV protection and circuit breakers for safety. On Uniswap v4, we implemented a dynamic fee hook that adjusts based on volume and slippage, helping LPs manage risk and avoid bad trades.

One of the most important parts of the platform is our Insurance feature. Users can choose to stake into insurance vaults linked to specific tokens. If a token experiences a rugpull or suspicious activity — like liquidity being pulled or major contract changes — affected users can file an on-chain claim. These payouts are covered by community-funded vaults, yield fees, and LP rewards. It’s a way for communities to protect each other and build trust around a token.

We also built an AI-powered dashboard using Llama AI Model that collects Web data — like tweets, sentiment, and token page info — and displays it in an easy-to-understand format within the chat area. This helps token holders understand the broader context of their token and stay informed.

Overall, our project gives any memecoin or community token a way to evolve — with tools for yield, protection, and better communication. It turns short-term hype into long-term community-driven value.
